title: Fish Farming: One Fish Two Fish
description: Fish Farming: One Fish Two Fish — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Temdewm

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 9 One Fish and 11 Two Fish in Vergrim's Vexation

Quest Reward: 2,125 Gold and 1 Kings Coin.

Return to: Sir Temdewm

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go and Collect 9 One Fish and 11 Two Fish from the Mutants and Bring them back to Sir Tendewm on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation.

Offer:

One Fish and Two Fish, whatever those are, are the first two items on the list. You have collected these before so it shouldn't be a problem getting more. Once you have collected all the fish return to me, Sir Tendewm, here on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation for your reward.

Turn-in:

Ok, looks like you have all the fish that were needed. Here is a little something for you. Let me know when you are ready to get started again.

Objectives:

  • One Fish ×9
  • Two Fish ×11

Level range: 17–30
